Name: Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes - A Barns and Coops Overhaul
Author: lindest
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/7ETAzw8.png[/img][/size][/center]

[size=3]A place for everything, and everything in its place. Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes adds brand new barn and coop interiors. Powered by mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties (MMAP)[/url], animals now have specific spawn points inside the map. They will begin each day in their respective stall or box, and return to them when it is time to sleep. Animals can move freely and are not trapped in their spaces.[/size]

[size=3]Deluxe barns and coops have a well-lit work room for artisan machines. The main space has a working day-night cycle and gets fully dark for sleeping animals. Animals should be excluded from the work rooms by map properties.[/size]

[size=3]Version 1.2 has its own .dll, coded by bitswitch. The .dll should fix most of the issues enumerated in Troubleshooting.[/size]


[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/8XXZnom.png[/img][/size][/center]


[center][b][size=5]Compatibility:[/size][/b][/center]

[size=3]WSCB is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life (Rebirth)[/url]. Both of these profession overhauls change the number of animals you can have in a building as you progress. (Please do not try to play with both; they are exclusive to each other.)[/size]

[size=3]WSCB is compatible with mods that add new animals. Mods that add large animals to the coops will not look as intended. Coop animals are expected to fit on one tile (16x16 pixels). Barn animals larger than two square tiles (32x32 pixels) may or may not fit into the stalls.[/size]

[size=3]Unless specified below, WSCB is [i]not[/i] compatible with mods that change the barn and coop interiors.[/size]

[size=3]When you want to be less [i]cozy[/i] and more [i]industrial[/i], try a compatible mod. These new maps come in size 16, 20, 24, 40, 48, and 64. Or go minimalist with tiny farm buildings![/size]

[center][b][size=5]Configuration:[/size][/b][/center]

[size=4][b]Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes config[/b]:[/size]
[size=3][i]Recolor:[/i] Leave blank to auto-detect.  WSCB has a few unique assets. Choose which recolor closest fits your needs.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url] ﻿[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Wall Color[/i]: Choose from 24 colors to customize the interiors of your buildings. The map overlay and some of the colors come from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]nykachu[/url]. (Thanks!) The rest are custom to this mod.[/size]

[size=3][i]Barns[/i] and [i]Coops[/i]: Can be toggled on/off. For the most streamlined experience, make this choice from the main menu.[/size]

[size=3][i]Coops for Profession Overhauls[/i] and [i]Barns for Profession Overhauls[/i]:  Can be toggled on/off. This is intended as a mid-game change, for progression purposes. Only takes effect when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]VPP[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]WOL[/url] is installed, and is meant to replace the maps in those mods.[/size]

[size=3][i]Hay Recolor[/i]:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]If "Recolored", the feed hay and the ornamental hay bale item will be recolored to match the floor hay colors provided by recolor mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If "MedievalMatch", floor hay, coop boxes, and hay bales will instead be colored with Gwen's seasonal hay colors. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]. The incubator, hay hopper, and ornamental hay bale will also match those colors if you are not using Gwen's sprites for those items. WSCB detects those choices with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url]﻿.﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If left blank, WSCB will not recolor extra hay items.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Shane's 8-Heart Scene[/i]: A WSCB-style map edit for a particular event scene. This does not change the event, just the set dressing. Choose *Worn* for Vanilla-like. Choose *Fresh* for a clean building. Totally optional![/size]

[spoiler][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/VjQYmt4.png[/img][/size][/spoiler]
[size=3][i]Alternate Coop Door Position:[/i] By request! Shifts the position of the interior coop door so that it opens into the workroom. [/size]

[b][size=4]Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes Code config: [/size][/b]
[size=3][i]Harmony Patches:[/i] Enables harmony patches needed to make this mod work with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44285] Ultimate Ultimate Coop and Barn[/url] mods. Turns off these mods' item movements so that WSCB can take priority. Also patches out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url]'s map edits which continued to conflict. Expect to use both [i]Coops[/i] and [i]Barns[/i] if you are using these mods. Does nothing if these mods are not installed. Defaults to enabled. Requires a full game restart to change.[/size]

[size=3][i]Misplaced Hay Remediation:[/i] Enables mod's ability to move misplaced hay back into troughs. If there is more hay on the map than open trough slots, it will attempt to return excess hay to a silo. If no silo is available, it will delete hay. Defaults to enabled.[/size]

[size=3][i]Forced Machine Placement:[/i] Enables mod's control of machine placement (e.g. hopper, incubator, auto-grabber). Checks for expected machines bundled in a building's tier and attempts to place them where it believes they belong. Especially useful for when this mod is added mid-save. Defaults to enabled. Disable if you are turning off [i]Coops[/i] or [i]Barns[/i], or if you want total control. This should not move machines that were added by the player.[/size]

[size=3][i]Debug Mode:[/i] Enables verbose logging for the .dll.[/size]


[center][b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b][/center]

[size=3]WSCB requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url].[/size]
[size=3]It is strongly recommended that you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed.[/size]

[size=3]Please cleanly uninstall version 1.1 before upgrading to version 1.3.[/size]

[size=3][b]For Android users[/b]: this mod and its .dll have been tested on SMAPI for Android version 4.3.2.5. You may need to follow community steps to get MMAP working. I do not play on Android and can offer only limited support. Until SMAPI 4.4 is available for Android, the Android-specific version of this mod will require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30001]Arbitrary Tilesheet Access[/url].[/size]


[center][b][size=5]Troubleshooting:[/size][/b][/center]
[size=3][i]Help! I'm in the void!

[/i]You toggled the map while standing inside the building. Reverse the toggle and go outside to make your changes. Animals should snap back into bounds with a map transition.[/size]


[size=3][i][s]My feed hay is stuck in the old position.[/s]

[/i]Fixed with [i]Misplaced Hay Remediation[/i] in the .dll.[/size]


[size=3][i][s]My machines are in a weird place[/s].

[/i]Fixed with [i]Forced Machine Placement [/i]in the .dll.[/size]

[size=3]If you choose not to use [i]Forced Machine Placement[/i], move misplaced objects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url]﻿.[/size]


[size=3][i]My artisan machines are in the void.

[/i]Don't toggle off or uninstall the mod without first removing your equipment from the map. WSCB maps are much larger than vanilla.[/size]


[size=3][i]My auto-grabber is not working.[/i][/size]

[size=3]This appears to be a vanilla issue. The auto-grabber sometimes fails to function if it spawns from a building upgrade. Picking it up and putting it back down will fix it.[/size]


[size=3][i]Something seems broken and I want lindest to fix it.[/i][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Close the game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Set "Debug Mode" in the "Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes Code" config to [i]true[/i].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Start the game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Load your problem save and enter an animal building.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Paste into console:[/size]



[code]﻿patch summary lindest.stallsboxes[/code][/*]
[*][size=3]Let this command load. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Share your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] in a comment or a bug report.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3] In your comment, tell me:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]if you loaded this mod mid save or on a fresh game[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]if you have a guess about what other mods aren't working with it[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]if you're using a mod that changes barns and coops in any way[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]if you're playing on android or PC[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]how to replicate the error[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]if you can show the problem with a screenshot[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=1]This mod was inspired by nuupon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28462]Immersive Barns and Coops[/url]﻿. WSCB is built from scratch and contains only its own assets except when noted otherwise. Chickens are not meant to sleep in nesting boxes for sanitary reasons. Good thing these aren't nesting boxes! They're... sleeping boxes... because rabbits can't perch on roosts.[/size]
